title: Karmina Constantino’s newsroom routine includes greeting Sharon Cuneta’s poster
summary: Broadcast journalist Karmina Constantino showed that she is just like any other fangirl after she gave a glimpse of her simple ritual before heading to the newsroom: greeting her idol, Sharon Cuneta.…

blocks.text: Broadcast journalist Karmina Constantino showed that she is just like any other fangirl after she gave a glimpse of her simple ritual before heading to the newsroom: greeting her idol, Sharon Cuneta. Constantino recently shared a compilation of clips showing her stopping by Cuneta’s poster at the ABS-CBN headquarters, where she would briefly greet the actress and singer before proceeding to the newsroom. “Syempre nagmamadali ako kasi gusto ko magbigay pugay muna kay Megastar before we go in to the newsroom,” Constantino said in one of the clips.
